name: Screw Puzzle:Happy Jam
summary:
🎯Welcome to Screw Puzzle: Happy Jam! Have relaxing fun as you navigate a world of screw pin, nuts and bolts puzzles!

Screw Puzzle: Happy Jam is a relaxing 3D screw puzzle game set in an MR VR space! You will be challenged to solve a puzzle where you must unscrew intricately intertwined 3D structures, one screw at a time. You'll clear the stage once all the screws have been removed, and all the parts have fallen. Enjoy a peaceful puzzle experience while relaxing music plays.
